text: {"title":"HTTP Latency","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"latency-percentiles","title":"Latency percentiles over time","description":"Computes the p50, p95 and p99 of request duration in milliseconds for each one-minute bucket across all HTTP requests.","viz":"line","format":"ms","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p99 FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute","timeField":"minute"},"options":{"unit":"ms","decimals":0,"legend":"bottom","yAxis":{"min":0,"label":"Latency (ms)"}},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"slowest-routes","title":"Slowest routes by p95","description":"Ranks routes by their p95 request duration in milliseconds over the dashboard window to identify the slowest endpoints.","viz":"bar","format":"ms","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95 FROM http_requests GROUP BY route ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 10"},"options":{"unit":"ms","decimals":0,"legend":"none","yAxis":{"min":0,"label":"p95 latency (ms)"}},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}}]}
